item.title: Morrisons to offload dozens of in-store pharmacies
item.description: Morrisons has put some of its pharmacies up for sale as it seeks to make the supermarket financially sustainable.

item.title: Waitrose extends Flooid tie-up and secures new POS deal
item.description: Waitrose has renewed its partnership with commerce platform Flooid for another five years, as it secures a new point of sale (POS) technology deal.

item.title: How retailers are tackling safety beyond the store
item.description: Violence and abuse have become a perceived part of the job for retail colleagues. This is in addition to the demands on them including shift work, customer-facing roles and high-pressure trading periods. item.title: Topshop launches in 32 John Lewis stores
item.description: Topshop has returned to the UK high street through a new nationwide partnership with John Lewis, marking the brand’s first large-scale physical retail presence in recent years.

item.title: Co-op launches gender pay gap toolkit
item.description: Supermarket chain Co-op has collaborated with Women in Hospitality, Travel and Leisure (WiHTL) and Diversity in Retail (DiR) to unveil its new gender pay toolkit. The toolkit aims to close the gender pay gap by helping organisations pursue “meaningful change” and is designed to prepare companies for strengthened gender pay gap action requirements coming into effect...

item.title: Former Matches exec debuts athleisure brand
item.description: Former Matches chief commercial officer (CCO) Carl Tallents has rolled out a new athleisure brand, in a bid to target growth in the premium activewear sector.

item.title: Debenhams shares fall dramatically as group pushes for £35m fundraising
item.description: Debenhams Group shares fell sharply in early trading after the online fashion retailer confirmed plans for a £35m equity fundraise, reportedly aimed at strengthening its balance sheet and accelerating its turnaround strategy. item.title: Asda hails continued ‘strong’ ESG performance
item.description: Asda has hailed a “strong” environmental, social and governance (ESG) performance for the third year in a row, following its external assessment by financial services ratings’ agency Sustainable Fitch.

item.title: What rising unemployment means for an industry already under pressure
item.description: The latest data from the ONS has shown that as of early 2026, unemployment within the UK is facing a five year high. item.title: EU probes Shein over sale of childlike sex dolls and weapons
item.description: The EU is launching a formal investigation into Shein over multiple suspected breaches of European laws, including the sale of childlike sex dolls and weapons.
